study: RoPE-only counterfactual for BF16 full versus cached attention

policies.original: Only cached attention rounds FP32 rotation tables to the query dtype
policies.shared_fp32: Both routes rotate in FP32, then explicitly cast query/key back to the original dtype
policies.shared_bf16: Both routes round rotation tables to BF16 before rotation

frozen_probe: Identical actual pre-rotation query/key operands and tables; report post-rotation and post-cast comparisons separately
full_model: BF16 full/prefill/tokenwise/real-prefix continuation and memory comparisons; common unchanged FP32 anchor and descriptive true-target loss
limits: Temporary instance-scoped treatments; restore hooks and forwards even on failure
Shared FP32 includes an explicit final cast and is a treatment, not identical historical full-path arithmetic
A BF16 rotation inconsistency cannot explain the separate FP32 scan disagreement
No production defaults, checkpoint weights, thresholds or training trajectories change
Selection-pool window is diagnostic only; no quality-equivalence margin
